title: Geometric finite-fibre mate and counit arrows with ordinary representative normalization
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$, an algebraic closure $\Omega/\mathbf Q_\ell$, schemes $X,Y,s$, maps $f:X\to Y$, $y:s\to Y$, and geometric comparison data $G$ [def-zl-finite-restriction-geometric-comparisons]. Write $S=X\times_Ys$, $v,h$ for its projections and $i_x$ for its canonical fibre-point lifts [lem-zl-finite-counit-restriction-towers]. At each finite coefficient stage use the actual completed pullback $\widehat P_g$ [def-pur-integral-derived-operations], ordinary ringed derived pullback $P_g$, and the canonical completion map $\eta_g:P_g\to\widehat P_g$ specified on flat-term K-flat representatives by the quotient augmentation and zero second Roos-cone coordinate [lem-tw-ordinary-completed-integral-pullback]. Retain ordinary derived adjunctions $P_g\dashv F_g$ for $g=f,h$, where $F_g$ is ordinary completed-ring direct image [def-weil-derived-direct-image]. Their underlying pushforward comparison is identity on sections. Their Hom bijection sends the universal pullback counit followed by the localization of any cochain map to the localization of its actual ordinary cochain adjunct followed by the right-derived cochain unit. Retain ordinary direct-image pasting for $(h,y),(v,f),(i_x,h),(i_x,v)$, fixed on every section by the actual fibre-product pasting isomorphism, and its conjugate ordinary pullback compositor. Its derived compositor is fixed on every flat-term K-flat representative by the two universal pullback counits and that cochain compositor. Retain the direct-image identity fixed by actual identity fibre-product restriction and the conjugate pullback identity, with the same derived cochain normalization.

A geometric arrow datum consists of the actual constructible restriction of $\widehat P_f$, completed adjunctions $\widehat P_f\dashv I_f$ and $\widehat P_h\dashv I_h$, the completed pullback square, and the point comparisons $i_x^*h^*\simeq1$, $i_x^*v^*\simeq x^*$. Here $I_f,I_h$ are the retained strict-image functors with their normalized reconstruction [lem-sf-strict-direct-image-scalar-comparison]. The completed adjunction unit is the ordinary unit followed by ordinary direct image of $\eta_g$, followed by that reconstruction. The completed square and point compositors are specified by the ordinary derived compositors above: precomposing by the two actual completion units gives the ordinary square or point identity, followed by the units on the other side. The geometric exchange is the mate of this square under these adjunctions. Each geometric restriction component is inverse $h i_x=1$ comparison followed by $i_x^*$ of the actual $h$-counit and the $v i_x=x$ comparison. For endpoint identifications $N$ between an integral strict-system diagram and these geometric composites [def-zl-finite-restriction-integral-diagram], arrow normalization asserts that $N_{\mathrm{source}}^{-1}$ followed by strict exchange followed by $N_{\mathrm{middle}}$ equals the geometric mate, and $N_{\mathrm{middle}}^{-1}$ followed by strict restriction and the $x$-projection equals the geometric point-counit component, for every stage, input and point. These are equalities of whole derived arrows.
